stem: What is one similarity between the excerpt from “Millennials. . . So Happy Together” and the excerpt from “The Leper’s Squint”?
instruction: Use “Millennials. . . So Happy Together” and “The Leper’s Squint” to answer the following question.

options.label: F
options.text: Both excerpts include different generations questioning the idea of co-living.

options.label: G
options.text: Both excerpts discuss how much money can be saved by sharing living and working spaces.

options.label: H
options.text: Both excerpts indicate that co-living situations require the ability to adapt to the environment.

options.label: J
options.text: Both excerpts declare shared living and working spaces as beneficial to all.
